source.name: BBC Sport: Chelsea announce new shirt sponsorship with Circle
source.quote: Chelsea have announced a new one-year front-of-shirt sponsorship deal with Circle Internet Group.

note: USDC stablecoin branding; replaces the front that had been vacant. One-year deal; BBC Sport says the value was 'believed to be about £50m per season, though the exact figures have not been given', so the amount is a reported estimate. usdApprox is a conversion at about $1.34 per £, not a reported figure.
